name: Multi-Host Partition Scheme
definition: A parallelization strategy where nodes are divided into groups, each with one host and several slaves, processing a subset of slices. It is a hybrid of host-slave and symmetry partitions, allowing load balancing by reassigning finished group nodes as slaves to other groups.
summary: The Multi-Host Partition Scheme is a parallel volume rendering strategy that groups nodes into independent host-slave units to solve load imbalance and I/O bottlenecks by dynamically reassigning idle nodes to busy groups.
